neighbours.label: consumable substances named as things taxed, banned or warned against (fat, sugar, fluoride, white wine)
fire: The government dropped its tax on fat and its plans for a tax on sugar.
Doctors warn that young children should never drink fluoridated water.
She avoided the cocktails and chose water instead of white wine.
The school banned soda and sweets from its vending machines.
Fluoride in toothpaste and mouth rinses can harm toddlers if swallowed.
The city added a levy on salt and sugary drinks last year.
Pregnant women are told to avoid alcohol and raw fish.
The diet forbids butter, cream and red meat for a month.
quiet: The government dropped its tax on cars and its plans for a tax on fuel.
Doctors warn that young children should never cross busy roads.
She avoided the crowd and chose the garden instead of the hall.
The school banned phones and headphones from its classrooms.
Brushes and floss can harm toddlers' gums if used roughly.
The city added a levy on parking and hotel stays last year.
Pregnant women are told to avoid hot tubs and heavy lifting.
The plan forbids overtime, travel and new hires for a month.

notes: Card is mixed (fat, fluoridated, wood, loan, white). Low confidence.
